---
title: "Ethiopia pig numbers"
output: html_notebook
date: 2026-11-07
---

This analysis describes Ethiopia's livestock stocks and meat production using
[FAOSTAT Crops and livestock products](https://www.fao.org/faostat/en/#data/QCL).
The source is `FAOSTAT_data_en_11-7-2026.csv`, downloaded on 7 November 2026.
It covers modern Ethiopia (area code 231), 1993–2024. The original download
and its flags are retained; estimates and imputations are not treated as
independent census observations. The original CSV is included in `data/` so the analysis can be reproduced.
Open this notebook from the updated/ folder. Generated figures are saved
to `figures/`.

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(ggrepel)
library(patchwork)

### read data
# Open this notebook or run it from the updated/ folder.
project_dir = "."
data_dir = file.path(project_dir, "data")
faostat = read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "FAOSTAT_data_en_11-7-2026.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
# Keep the full source for the meat-production analysis below.
animals = faostat
# Restrict both panels to modern Ethiopia, excluding Ethiopia PDR.
animals = animals %>%
  filter(Area == "Ethiopia", Area.Code..M49. == 231,
         Element == "Stocks", Year >= 1993) %>%
  arrange(Item, Year)
pigs = animals[animals$Item == "Swine / pigs",]

# Non-pig stocks for the second panel; retain species, units, and FAO flags.
non_pigs = animals %>%
  filter(Item != "Swine / pigs") %>%
  mutate(
    # Chickens are reported in thousands of animals. Bee stocks (No) are
    # retained but cannot be compared as animal head counts.
    head = case_when(
      Unit == "An" ~ Value,
      Unit == "1000 An" ~ Value * 1000,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(Item, Year)

# Preserve flags alongside the pig-stock time series.
pigs = pigs %>%
  dplyr::select(Year, Value, Unit, Flag, Flag.Description) %>%
  dplyr::rename(year = Year, pigs = Value) %>%
  arrange(year)

# descriptive statistics
summary_stats = pigs %>%
  arrange(year) %>% 
  summarise(
    first_year    = first(year),
    last_year     = last(year),
    first_pigs    = first(pigs),
    last_pigs     = last(pigs),
    n_years       = nrow(.),
    mean_pigs     = mean(pigs, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_pigs       = sd(pigs, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_pigs   = median(pigs, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_pigs      = min(pigs, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_pigs      = max(pigs, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_change    = ((last(pigs) - first(pigs)) / first(pigs)) * 100
  )

print(summary_stats)
pig_stock_flags = pigs %>% count(Flag, Flag.Description, name = "n_years")
print(pig_stock_flags)

# Match the publication-category figure and locality map palette.
animal_colors = c(
  "Pigs" = "#CC79A7", "Cattle" = "#C6A7D8",
  "Chickens" = "#E3CFA8", "Goats" = "#A8C6B3", "Sheep" = "#BFC3C7"
)

# Panel A: pig stocks on a linear scale.
plot_theme = theme_classic(base_size = 17) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 15, color = "black"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 20),
    plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20),
    plot.tag.position = c(0.02, 0.98),
    plot.margin = margin(12, 10, 8, 8),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
year_breaks = sort(unique(c(1995, 2005, 2015, max(pigs$year))))

pig_panel = ggplot(pigs, aes(year, pigs)) +
  geom_line(color = animal_colors[["Pigs"]], linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(color = animal_colors[["Pigs"]], size = 2, alpha = 0.95) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = year_breaks) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Pigs (head)") +
  plot_theme

# Panel B: the four largest non-pig populations in the latest year, plus pigs.
latest_year = max(non_pigs$Year, na.rm = TRUE)
top_species = non_pigs %>%
  filter(Year == latest_year, !is.na(head), head > 0) %>%
  slice_max(head, n = 4, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  pull(Item)
non_pig_plot_data = non_pigs %>%
  filter(Item %in% top_species, !is.na(head), head > 0)
comparison_plot_data = bind_rows(
  non_pig_plot_data %>% select(Year, Item, head),
  pigs %>% transmute(Year = year, Item = "Pigs", head = pigs)
) %>%
  mutate(Item = factor(Item, levels = c("Pigs", top_species)))

endpoint_labels = comparison_plot_data %>% filter(Year == latest_year)

non_pig_panel = ggplot(comparison_plot_data,
                       aes(Year, head, color = Item, group = Item)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.5) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = endpoint_labels, aes(label = Item),
    nudge_x = 1.5, direction = "y", hjust = 0,
    size = 4.8, color = "#333333", segment.color = "#888888",
    segment.size = 0.35, min.segment.length = 0,
    box.padding = 0.4, point.padding = 0.15,
    max.overlaps = Inf, seed = 17
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = animal_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = year_breaks, expand = expansion(mult = c(0.04, 0.32))) +
  scale_y_log10(
    breaks = c(1e4, 1e5, 1e6, 1e7, 1e8),
    labels = c("10,000", "100,000", "1 million", "10 million", "100 million")
  ) +
  labs(x = "Year",
       y = "Animals (head; log scale)") +
  guides(color = "none") +
  plot_theme

combined_figure = (pig_panel | non_pig_panel) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  theme(legend.position = "none")

print(combined_figure)
output_dir = file.path(project_dir, "figures")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "ethiopia_livestock_two_panels.png"),
       combined_figure, width = 13.5, height = 5.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```


## Meat production and slaughter



```{r meat-production}
meat_items = c(
  "Pigs" = "Meat of pig with the bone, fresh or chilled",
  "Cattle" = "Meat of cattle with the bone, fresh or chilled",
  "Goats" = "Meat of goat, fresh or chilled",
  "Sheep" = "Meat of sheep, fresh or chilled",
  "Chickens" = "Meat of chickens, fresh or chilled",
  "Camels" = "Meat of camels, fresh or chilled"
)
meat_data = faostat %>%
  filter(Area == "Ethiopia", Area.Code..M49. == 231,
         Year >= 1993, Item %in% unname(meat_items)) %>%
  mutate(Species = names(meat_items)[match(Item, meat_items)]) %>%
  arrange(Species, Year, Element)

# Compare production in tonnes, using the same year for all six species.
meat_production = meat_data %>%
  filter(Element == "Production", Unit == "t", !is.na(Value)) %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  mutate(share_percent = 100 * Value / sum(Value)) %>%
  ungroup()
latest_meat_year = meat_production %>%
  count(Year) %>%
  filter(n == length(meat_items)) %>%
  summarise(year = max(Year)) %>%
  pull(year)

slaughter_data = meat_data %>%
  filter(Element == "Producing Animals/Slaughtered") %>%
  mutate(slaughtered_head = case_when(
    Unit == "An" ~ Value,
    Unit == "1000 An" ~ Value * 1000,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_
  )) %>%
  select(Species, Year, slaughtered_head,
         slaughter_flag = Flag,
         slaughter_flag_description = Flag.Description)

meat_comparison = meat_production %>%
  filter(Year == latest_meat_year) %>%
  select(Species, Year, production_tonnes = Value, share_percent,
         production_flag = Flag,
         production_flag_description = Flag.Description) %>%
  left_join(slaughter_data, by = c("Species", "Year")) %>%
  arrange(desc(production_tonnes))

knitr::kable(
  meat_comparison %>%
    select(Species, Year, production_tonnes, share_percent,
           slaughtered_head, production_flag, slaughter_flag),
  digits = c(0, 0, 2, 3, 0, 0, 0),
  col.names = c("Species", "Year", "Meat production (tonnes)",
                "Share of six-species production (%)", "Animals slaughtered",
                "Production flag", "Slaughter flag"),
  caption = paste("FAOSTAT meat production and slaughter estimates,",
                  latest_meat_year)
)

pig_meat_summary = meat_production %>%
  filter(Species == "Pigs") %>%
  arrange(Year) %>%
  summarise(
    first_year = first(Year), last_year = last(Year),
    first_tonnes = first(Value), last_tonnes = last(Value),
    pct_change = 100 * (last(Value) / first(Value) - 1)
  )
print(pig_meat_summary)
meat_flags = meat_data %>%
  filter(Species == "Pigs") %>%
  count(Element, Flag, Flag.Description, name = "n_years")
print(meat_flags)
```

`E` denotes an estimated value and `I` a value imputed by a receiving agency.
All 2024 production values in this table are imputed. The pig share uses only
the six listed meat categories, excluding offal, fat, and game meat.


## Meat-production trends

```{r meat-production-plot, fig.width=13.5, fig.height=5.5}
# Panel A shows pig-meat output on a linear scale; panel B compares
# all six meat categories on a logarithmic scale using the same tonne units.
meat_colors = c(animal_colors, "Camels" = "#B89B7A")
meat_year_breaks = sort(unique(c(1995, 2005, 2015, latest_meat_year)))
pig_meat_plot_data = meat_production %>%
  filter(Species == "Pigs") %>%
  arrange(Year)
meat_plot_data = meat_production %>%
  filter(Value > 0) %>%
  mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels = names(meat_items)))
meat_endpoint_labels = meat_plot_data %>%
  filter(Year == latest_meat_year)

pig_meat_panel = ggplot(pig_meat_plot_data, aes(Year, Value)) +
  geom_line(color = meat_colors[["Pigs"]], linewidth = 1.1) +
  geom_point(color = meat_colors[["Pigs"]], size = 2, alpha = 0.95) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = meat_year_breaks) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Pig-meat production (tonnes)") +
  plot_theme

meat_comparison_panel = ggplot(
  meat_plot_data, aes(Year, Value, color = Species, group = Species)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.5) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = meat_endpoint_labels, aes(label = Species),
    nudge_x = 1.5, direction = "y", hjust = 0,
    size = 4.8, color = "#333333", segment.color = "#888888",
    segment.size = 0.35, min.segment.length = 0,
    box.padding = 0.4, point.padding = 0.15,
    max.overlaps = Inf, seed = 17
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = meat_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = meat_year_breaks, expand = expansion(mult = c(0.04, 0.32))
  ) +
  scale_y_log10(
    breaks = c(1e3, 1e4, 1e5, 1e6),
    labels = scales::label_comma()
  ) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Meat production (tonnes; log scale)") +
  guides(color = "none") +
  plot_theme

meat_figure = (pig_meat_panel | meat_comparison_panel) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  theme(legend.position = "none")

print(meat_figure)
ggsave(
  file.path(output_dir, "ethiopia_meat_production_two_panels.png"),
  plot = meat_figure, width = 13.5, height = 5.5,
  units = "in", dpi = 300, bg = "white"
)
```

## Main figure: livestock populations and meat production

```{r livestock-and-meat-main-figure, fig.width=13.5, fig.height=5.5}
# Compare the same six species in both main-figure panels.
# The pig-only panels above can be retained as supplementary figures.
main_stock_data = animals %>%
  filter(Item %in% c("Swine / pigs", setdiff(names(meat_items), "Pigs"))) %>%
  mutate(
    Species = if_else(Item == "Swine / pigs", "Pigs", Item),
    head = case_when(
      Unit == "An" ~ Value,
      Unit == "1000 An" ~ Value * 1000,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    Species = factor(Species, levels = names(meat_items))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(head), head > 0)
main_stock_labels = main_stock_data %>% filter(Year == latest_meat_year)
main_stock_panel = ggplot(
  main_stock_data, aes(Year, head, color = Species, group = Species)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.5) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = main_stock_labels, aes(label = Species),
    nudge_x = 1.5, direction = "y", hjust = 0,
    size = 4.8, color = "#333333", segment.color = "#888888",
    segment.size = 0.35, min.segment.length = 0,
    box.padding = 0.4, point.padding = 0.15,
    max.overlaps = Inf, seed = 17
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = meat_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = meat_year_breaks, expand = expansion(mult = c(0.04, 0.32))
  ) +
  scale_y_log10(
    breaks = c(1e4, 1e5, 1e6, 1e7, 1e8),
    labels = c("10,000", "100,000", "1 million", "10 million", "100 million")
  ) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Animals (head; log scale)") +
  guides(color = "none") +
  plot_theme

livestock_and_meat_figure = (main_stock_panel | meat_comparison_panel) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  theme(legend.position = "none")

print(livestock_and_meat_figure)
ggsave(
  file.path(output_dir, "ethiopia_livestock_and_meat.png"),
  plot = livestock_and_meat_figure, width = 13.5, height = 5.5,
  units = "in", dpi = 300, bg = "white"
)
ggsave(
  file.path(output_dir, "ethiopia_livestock_and_meat.tiff"),
  plot = livestock_and_meat_figure, width = 13.5, height = 5.5,
  units = "in", dpi = 300, compression = "lzw", bg = "white"
)
```
